title: Posting rule entry
description: Typed object form of one posting rule in Bea's posting-rule register (per Team/Bea.md §11). A posting rule maps a typed event (postable product event) to one or more double-entry GL postings. Bea + Atlas co-own publication; each rule emits a PostingRulePublished event.

eventType.description: The fully-qualified event type this rule fires on, e.g. 'TradePosted', 'FundingDrawn', 'PaymentSettled', 'AccrualBooked'. Resolves to a typed event schema in @platform/event-store.

preconditions.description: Predicates over the event payload that the rule requires before firing. Multi-rule fan-out per event uses preconditions to disambiguate.

accountId.description: Chart-of-accounts ID. Must resolve to an in-force account in `_chart-of-accounts.md`.

amountExpression.description: Expression over the event payload yielding the posting amount, e.g. 'event.amount.value'. Substrate-grade engine (planned, M2) parses this; today the expression is human-validated.

currencyExpression.description: Expression over the event payload yielding the ISO 4217 currency, e.g. 'event.amount.ccy'. Per Principle 5, no currency default — the rule fails if the expression returns null.

entityExpression.description: Expression yielding the legal-entity ID. Defaults to event.entityId.

postings.description: Two or more postings (debit + credit, balanced). Multi-leg postings (e.g., trade with FX leg) are expressed as additional balanced pairs.

approver.description: Bea (within delegation) / Camille (above materiality) / AC (material policy change).
